notes: Card: ' �' (a space plus an incomplete UTF-8 byte) is the peak of 22 of the top 32, in Chinese text with spaces and in Korean; flagged broad (1.7% of tokens reach 0.1 of max); the output promotes '大' / ' big' / ' large'. Probes: Korean sentences 0.85 and 0.35, space-separated Chinese 0.38, 0.51 and 0.36; the same Chinese sentence without spaces 0.02, Japanese 0.00, spaced kanji city names 0.02 (those are whole tokens), English 'big ... large' 0.05. Which characters split into a partial-byte piece depends on the tokenizer, so strength varies by sentence.
